authority: Failed disposable targets are immutable evidence. They were not deleted, reused, promoted, or represented as readiness receipts.

attempts.exact_failure: offline config replacement anchor drift: '  enabled: true\n  force-night:'
attempts.cause: The harness assumed adjacent unlit.enabled and force-night keys although world and buildmode keys intervene.

attempts.exact_failure: TERRAIN FAIL: minimum sampled surface Y -61 gives only -247 blocks above the highest non-Mouth roof; requires 12
attempts.cause: Minecraft 1.21.11's default flat preset placed its surface near the world minimum; the requested Y 200 Mouth could not satisfy buried-roof cover.

attempts.exact_failure: V5 fresh physical install failed: KS01/strips: movable frame set is incomplete: 5/6 unique pieces present

read_only_nbt_diagnosis.root_cause: Displaced-frame recovery used item identity inside a deliberately shuffled movable set. While reconciling the adjacent ks01_lu target it stole the prior target's ks01_lu piece, removed that frame, then replaced the moved item with the next deterministic shuffled item.
read_only_nbt_diagnosis.required_fix: Movable frame sets may never infer target displacement from item identity; a missing movable target remains a blocker rather than consuming a neighboring piece.

attempts.exact_failure: V5 exact book mount install failed: lc_founding_minutes has no safe lectern cell at kept_light_home_01; orin_certificate has no safe lectern cell at orin_marker_6

diagnosis.root_cause: Fallback book-mount depth used the opposite of each fixture's authored front, placing candidate lecterns behind the holder rather than in its public approach space.
diagnosis.orin_observation: All tested rear-side candidates for orin_marker_6 were occupied by the retained stone envelope, so the strict pass correctly refused to overwrite them.
diagnosis.required_fix: Derive fallback positions from positive fixture-front depth while preserving claimed-cell, protected-cell, headroom, and solid-floor checks.

attempts.exact_failure: Failed to download mojang_1.21.11.jar: java.net.SocketException: Permission denied: connect
attempts.cause: The create-only target correctly contained the pinned Paper build but no Paperclip cache. Network-restricted validation could not redownload Mojang's server JAR.
attempts.required_fix: Copy an existing exact read-only Paperclip cache into a brand-new target, record every cache hash, and refuse any byte drift.
